newsitem.title: USA: Disney "Toy Story" video orders top 21 mln.
newsitem.headline: Disney "Toy Story" video orders top 21 mln.

text.p: Walt Disney Co said on Wednesday it had received more than 21 million orders from retailers for its "Toy Story" videocassettes.
In a statement, Disney said the initial orders for "Toy Story" topped those for the studio's most successful film of all time, "The Lion King."
"Toy Story," which has grossed more than $200 million, goes on sale October 29.
Disney said the launch was being supported by the largest ever promotional effort behind a single release, with help from a number of U.S. companies, such as Eastman Kodak and General Mills.
